title: Exhibition Stand Contractors Abu Dhabi & ADNEC | FANN
description: Exhibition stand contractors for Abu Dhabi and ADNEC shows. Review real FANN project photographs, design and build scope, venue responsibilities and your stand brief.
heading: Exhibition stand contractors in Abu Dhabi
subheading: Design and build for your Abu Dhabi show, with ADNEC responsibilities agreed around the actual allocation.
intro: FANN designs and builds exhibition stands for Abu Dhabi shows, supported by a Dubai office and joinery workshop in Umm Al Quwain. For an ADNEC project, start with your confirmed allocation, show manual and the work you need. Agree design, fabrication, transport, installation and dismantling in the proposal. The project photographs below distinguish ADNEC build-up, a completed Abu Dhabi gallery installation and Dubai stand references. FANN is an independent contractor, not an appointed official ADNEC supplier.

sections.heading: Choose a contractor against the actual Abu Dhabi brief
sections.text: Give each stand contractor the same show name, venue, hall, stand number, dimensions and open sides. Explain the products, demonstrations, reception, meetings and storage you need. Ask for a proposal that identifies the work and responsibilities, so an exclusion is not mistaken for a lower price.

sections.heading: What to agree for an ADNEC exhibition stand
sections.text: Use the current organiser manual and venue information for this show. Record who prepares drawings, submits them, responds to comments and orders utilities or overhead services. Confirm the access, installation and dismantling windows. The agreed scope, not a general contractor label, determines who does each task. No venue approval outcome is guaranteed.

sections.heading: Separate design deliverables from construction documents
sections.text: Agree the layout and concept visuals needed to review the stand, then identify the drawings, material details and specialist inputs needed for the proposed build. A rendered image helps explain the appearance; it does not replace structural calculations, service drawings or a required venue submission.

sections.heading: Fabrication supported by our Umm Al Quwain workshop
sections.text: The FANN joinery workshop supports production of the agreed stand elements. Confirm drawing revisions, quantities, materials and finish details before release. Identify specialist suppliers and service interfaces separately. Workshop photographs do not establish every trade, material grade, structural capacity or engineering approval.

sections.heading: Identify transport, installation and dismantling
sections.text: Name the parties responsible for transport, venue access, installation, handover checks, on-site support and dismantling. Mark storage, reuse and transport after the show as included, excluded or supplied by others. The programme must reflect the current show schedule and the agreed work, not a standard build duration.

sections.heading: Compare stand builders on the same included work
sections.text: Check the quoted structure, joinery, finishes, graphics, furniture, AV and lighting against the same brief. Confirm utilities, rigging, organiser charges, approvals and later changes separately. Share any existing stand elements intended for reuse so their condition and suitability can be reviewed before the proposal is agreed.

faqs.question: Can FANN act as an exhibition stand contractor for Abu Dhabi shows?
faqs.answer: Yes. FANN reviews exhibition stand design and build enquiries for Abu Dhabi, with a Dubai office and joinery workshop in Umm Al Quwain. Send the confirmed allocation, show and venue details, required dates and stand brief. Design, production, transport, installation and dismantling responsibilities are agreed for the actual project.

faqs.question: Are you an official or appointed ADNEC contractor?
faqs.answer: FANN is an independent exhibition stand contractor, not presented as an appointed official ADNEC supplier. For your show, use the current organiser manual and venue requirements. Agree the party responsible for drawings, submissions, services and site work in writing. A portfolio photograph is not evidence of venue appointment or approval.

faqs.question: What should I send for an Abu Dhabi or ADNEC stand quotation?
faqs.answer: Send the show, venue, hall, stand number, dimensions, open sides and floor plan. Add the current exhibitor manual, brand assets, product or demonstration needs, meeting and storage requirements, and required dates. Identify any existing equipment or stand elements. These inputs help define the proposed work, exclusions and unresolved responsibilities.

faqs.question: Which photographs show real FANN work in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: The linked FALCOR and OILSERV galleries show stand build-up at ADIPEC 2026 in ADNEC Abu Dhabi. National Expression for ADEK is a completed Abu Dhabi gallery installation. Dubai archive stands are labelled separately. These photographs are project references, not proof of an official appointment, regulatory approval or measured visitor result.

faqs.question: How should I compare exhibition stand contractors for an ADNEC show?
faqs.answer: Give each contractor the same allocation and brief. Compare the quoted design, structure, finishes, graphics, equipment, transport, installation and dismantling. Identify services, fees, submissions, storage and support as included, excluded or supplied by others. Agree how later revisions affect the scope and programme before committing the work.
